entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
My new VeloBand Pulse isn't working.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Could I start with your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?

Thank you, Mark. Pulling up your account now... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 31st. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's broken. The band is defective. It won't sync with the app at all.
I see. So just to confirm, it's not a matter of fit or features, but the device is not functioning as expected?
Yes. It's not working. I want to return it.
Of course. I understand completely. Let me just pull up our return policy information for that item. One moment, please.

Okay, thanks for your patience, Mark. I've checked the policy, and I see that items can be returned within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 11, you are well within the window. I can start that return for you right now.
Fine. I'm surprised it was that simple.

I aim to make things easy. I also see that you're one of our VIP members. To apologize for the inconvenience with this defective band, I've gone ahead and added 500 bonus points to your account for a future purchase. I'm processing your return now, and you should receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next 15 minutes.
You're welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
